purpose: Teach: 佞/膺/从/レイプ/横田/中原/田口/五郎

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の佞言、つまり佞の虚偽報告を厳しく取り締まれ
lines.en: I want us to crack down hard on false reporting from staff. We can't have dishonesty.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Authoritative opening. Clear enunciation on key words. Steady pace that conveys seriousness without drama. No hesitation—these are expectations being set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の胸部、つまり膺保護パーツの品質を上げます
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen the quality of our protective components.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Slight forward lean in the posture of his voice. Confirms the instruction cleanly. Professional but not stiff—he's genuinely listening and committing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧字の从、つまり「從」を社印デザインから外せ
lines.en: And remove that old character from our company seal design.
lines.style: Sharp, specific instruction. Quick tempo on the opening phrase. No elaboration needed—the decision is already made. Expects acknowledgment without pushback.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内でレイプを含むハラスメント研修を厳しくします
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen our harassment training company-wide, including on serious misconduct.
lines.style: Firm commitment in his voice. Slightly slower pace to show this is being taken seriously. Respectful but not defensive—he understands the weight of what's being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、横田支社の地域連携を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen the regional connections at our Yokota branch.
lines.style: Task-focused delivery. Crisp consonants. Short, efficient phrasing that expects efficient execution. No ambiguity in the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中原氏の経営顧問就任を打診します
lines.en: Yes. I'll sound out Nakahara about taking on a management advisory role.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Taking down an assignment with quiet confidence. Steady voice that shows he's already thinking through the next steps. Professional and assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、写真担当の田口氏に新商品撮影を依頼しろ
lines.en: Have Taguchi—our photographer—shoot the new product line.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Brief pause to specify the role. Direct without being curt. The tone of someone delegating with confidence in the person receiving the task.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者ご縁の五郎氏に経営アドバイスを仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll reach out to Goro—one of our founder's old contacts—for management guidance.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the professionalism. Slight softening on the name and relationship note. Respectful of the connection being honoured. Closing with quiet completeness—this is settled.
